job.value: Set a competitive price using recent sold and active prices

arrivedFrom.value: The price insights entry in the sell form

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Price insights for Mew ex 216' with 'Sold prices' and a price field says what it's for.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Update' button under the 'S$ 42' price field is the strongest control.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Update' doesn't say it changes the draft's price, and the 'Lower' tag in the sold list doesn't say lower than what.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Raw/Graded' and 'Mint/Near Mint/Lightly Played' are standard TCG terms, and the sources are stated ('Carousell, eBay, and TCGplayer').

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It asks only for a price, with the hint 'Tough competition, price lower to sell faster' beside it.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The condition price grid, two averages, a trend line and the sold list all show at once rather than staying behind tabs.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything on screen serves pricing the card being listed.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The price field, hint line and figures carry it without any paragraphs.
